name: Last Term, First Love
source:
Welcome To Glenn State!

After over a year of intense study sessions and sleepless all-nighters, you’ve finally clawed your way out of the GPA pit you dug for yourself and transferred out of Glenn State’s backwater Kurtington campus. Now, in your final semester of college, you’ve made it to the university’s main campus: Glenn State College Valley, where the booze flows freely and the parties never stop (allegedly).

But it’s not that simple. With a graduation requirement of at least 3.00, you’re not exactly sitting pretty with a GPA of only 2.80.

Will you focus on your studies and secure your future?

Will you dive into the wild social scene and risk it all for the college experience you’ve been missing?

Or will you rise above the chaos and begin your epic comeback by graduating while winning the heart of someone truly special? 

[From [url=https://crazyrichbraddah.itch.io/last-term-first-love]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
欢迎来到格伦州立大学！

经过一年多的紧张学习和彻夜不眠，你终于从自己挖的GPA坑里爬出来，从格伦州立大学落后的库廷顿校区转学了。现在，在大学的最后一个学期，你已经到达了大学的主校区：格伦州立学院谷，那里酒水畅通，派对永不停息（据称）。

但事情没那么简单。毕业要求至少为3.00，而GPA只有2.80，你的成绩就不太好。

你会专注于你的学业并确保你的未来吗？

你会为了你一直怀念的大学经历而冒险投入到狂野的社交场景中吗？

或者你会摆脱混乱，通过毕业开始你的史诗般的东山再起，同时赢得真正特别的人的心？

[来自[url=https://crazyrichbraddah.itch.io/last-term-first-love]itch.io[/url]]
